Blog · Company · November 5, 2026
 Building the infrastructure for commerce's next chapter
 We've raised $15 million in Series A funding and launched Ask Agent, accelerating our mission to make every merchant ready for agentic commerce.
 KS
 Kumar Senthil
Co-founder and CEO, firmly
 AI is changing how people shop. Consumers are increasingly turning to AI
 assistants to research products, compare options, and decide what to buy.
 For merchants, that's an enormous opportunity, along with a practical
 challenge. Every new AI assistant, marketplace or shopping platform is another
 place to sell. But connecting to each one can take serious engineering,
 because catalogs, inventory, payments, and checkout all have to work together.
 At firmly, we believe merchants should be able to sell in every new
 destination without rebuilding their technology for each one.
 $15 million to build what's next
 Today we're announcing a $15 million Series A led by Squarepoint Capital, with
 participation from J.P. Morgan Payments, Mastercard, Samsung NEXT and other
 investors.
